description: This file defines a GatesService class responsible for evaluating gate conditions for data quality or compliance stages within a data insight platform. It includes methods to evaluate different scenarios such as freshness, schema conformity, and GXP baseline compliance, raising specific domain errors when checks fail.

classes.name: GatesService
classes.description: Service to evaluate gates for a draft, providing an evaluate method that checks different scenarios and raises errors accordingly.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] evaluate(self, *, draft_id: str, stage: str, scenario: str | None)
methods.description: Evaluates the specified stage gates based on the scenario provided; raises GateFailureDomainError if gates fail, otherwise returns a pass status.

ctags.name: evaluate
ctags.pattern: /^    def evaluate(self, *, draft_id: str, stage: str, scenario: str | None) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, *, draft_id: str, stage: str, scenario: str | None)
